Vault.SetTx reply and originating answer claim remain transactional. Strict clarificationResult is separate from owner-answer reconciliation evidence even through shared helper transport. Provider-confirmed completed source restores last-completed identity and the full redacted same-turn journal, including framed chunks, before existing positive question detection. Progress excerpts and bounded owner-answer evidence are not substituted; absence/invalid sources never confirm attention. Rebase comparison against9c549ce retains these owning source paths; conflict changes concern the shared transport, reporting shell and reconciliation context rather than changing this contract.
review.tests: Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Inspected every actual body of 38 inherited tests plus the current newer-owner and actual accepted-checkpoint controls, recorded individually in classification-test-review.json. Failures/checking/unconfirmed/malformed never add attention; setup/form/clarification share durable 2; native/async delivery and attempts survive restart; duplicate routes retire atomically with history; sibling answers accept exactly one and uncertain claims stay final. Combined native transaction retains matching supersession ordering; exact encrypted replies reopen from separate disk/Vault and reject duplicate overwrite/rollback. Chunked correction preserves pending Params under unchanged status/turn. No real-helper/host gap is closed. New real onMessage final-message crash window produces exactly one confirmed Messages route from a large Unicode question; ordinary text actually creates a resolved/no-input episode, repeated Recover does not duplicate or replay ordinary work. Causal takeover joins before shutdown. Current classification40-test lineage records38 unchanged prior bodies plus two changed/new bodies actually inspected.
